material.rule: AQS-STD-002 Rev A, rules M1 and M2. Acid-regen and leach liquor service: PVC. No metal wetted part.

density_kg_m3.note: Assumption. Typical PVC-U sheet density, not measured.

material.temperature_check: HL-Q3-A/B-HX5 carry Q3 water at supply 95 C, return 85 C (graph). Above PVC-U 60 C and CPVC 93 C. HX-5 ports and coil are PVDF per AQS-STD-002 section 3.2. Liquor temperature not on the graph; trip at 55 C (assumption).

header_zone_mm.note: Assumption. Depth reserved on each Y face inside the envelope for the inlet and outlet headers.

wall_mm.note: From AQS-NZ-001 (CSTR_NOZZLE_SCHEDULE.md) sheet wall 12 mm, now PVC. Not checked against hydrostatic load; liquor density is held.

floor_mm.note: From AQS-NZ-001 floor 16 mm, now PVC.

lid_bolt.note: Assumption. Non-metallic fasteners in the acid-gas head space (AQS-STD-002 M4).

header_od_mm.note: Assumption. 2 in Sch 80 PVC, ASTM D1785 OD.

port_od_mm_bore_not_calculated.note: Assumption. 1 in Sch 80 PVC placeholder; bore not calculated.

port_pitch_mm.note: Assumption. Ports spread along X about the face center at Z 700.
